from pathlib import Path
import math
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter
import artifact_io

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
W,H = 256,192
SRC = np.array(Image.open(ROOT/'first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
Y,X = np.mgrid[:H,:W]

def polygon(points):
    im=Image.new('L',(W*4,H*4)); d=ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    d.polygon([(round(x*4),round(y*4)) for x,y in points],fill=255)
    return np.array(im.resize((W,H),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)).astype(float)/255

# Each material patch belongs to exactly one rigid mechanical component.
LH=polygon([(54,78),(55,70),(62,67),(70,65),(78,61),(85,62),(90,64),(101,65),(105,68),(105,77),(100,79),(89,79),(80,83),(67,81),(61,79)])
LF=polygon([(70,78),(86,78),(90,82),(84,91),(78,101),(76,109),(73,118),(66,122),(57,119),(54,115),(56,107),(62,100),(66,98),(68,89),(65,83)])
LU=polygon([(57,114),(64,111),(72,117),(71,126),(76,136),(83,149),(91,154),(102,153),(109,157),(111,162),(106,168),(103,174),(94,175),(86,169),(82,161),(78,156),(71,145),(65,134),(60,125)])
RH=polygon([(146,76),(149,69),(154,67),(163,66),(169,64),(176,62),(183,64),(186,66),(195,67),(195,70),(190,74),(193,78),(187,81),(177,82),(167,80),(157,79)])
RF=polygon([(152,78),(164,76),(177,78),(182,85),(185,91),(179,99),(178,103),(186,109),(194,113),(194,118),(190,123),(185,126),(178,122),(172,117),(166,111),(169,104),(168,100),(155,99),(153,91)])
RU=polygon([(185,114),(194,115),(194,123),(185,132),(179,142),(174,151),(168,158),(166,164),(166,169),(158,177),(150,173),(148,167),(150,158),(149,154),(155,152),(165,155),(169,149),(176,138),(181,127),(177,122),(178,116)])
# Keep the bright fixed kitchen edge out of the moving link.
RU *= np.where((Y>126)&(SRC.mean(2)>105),0,1)
# Split fingers along their physical gap. Palm remains a separate rigid part.
left_finger=LH*polygon([(49,59),(80,59),(81,70),(73,77),(66,82),(49,83)])
right_finger=LH*polygon([(83,59),(110,60),(110,80),(90,82),(82,73)])
left_palm=np.maximum(0,LH-np.maximum(left_finger,right_finger))
r_f1=RH*polygon([(145,59),(166,59),(168,71),(158,80),(144,82)])
r_f2=RH*polygon([(169,59),(199,59),(199,82),(180,85),(168,74)])
r_palm=np.maximum(0,RH-np.maximum(r_f1,r_f2))

# Depth-sorted cutouts keep the photographed surface and all mechanical details.
parts=[('lu',LU),('ru',RU),('lf',LF),('rf',RF),('lh',left_palm),('l1',left_finger),('l2',right_finger),('rh',r_palm),('r1',r_f1),('r2',r_f2)]
remove=np.maximum.reduce([p[1] for p in parts])

# Reconstruct only surfaces formerly hidden by the arm; fixed pixels are untouched.
# The central strip is the same counter/sink material at the same perspective depth.
bg=SRC.astype(float).copy()
rng=np.random.default_rng(13)
fill=np.zeros_like(bg)
for y in range(H):
    row=SRC[y,112:143].astype(float)
    mean=np.median(row,axis=0)
    if y<69:
        row=SRC[y,112:142].astype(float)
        mean=np.median(row,axis=0)
    for x in range(W):
        sample=row[(x*7+11)%len(row)]
        fill[y,x]=mean + (sample-mean)*.36
# A gentle local interpolation restores reflective sink shading behind each wrist.
for y in range(60,72):
    for x in range(47,111):
        mix=np.clip((x-47)/64,0,1)
        a=SRC[y,45].astype(float);b=SRC[y,114].astype(float)
        fill[y,x]=a*(1-mix)+b*mix
    for x in range(146,197):
        fill[y,x]=np.median(SRC[y,116:141],axis=0)
# A little random but stationary microtexture prevents flat painted-out silhouettes.
noise=rng.normal(0,.65,(H,W,1))
fill=np.clip(fill+noise,0,255)
bg=bg*(1-remove[...,None])+fill*remove[...,None]
# Keep invariant bases and the parts of the workspace not exposed by the motion.
BASE_BG=bg.astype(np.uint8)
Image.fromarray(BASE_BG).save(ROOT/'background_candidate.png')

BOWL_CENTER=np.array([88.,54.])
# Ceramic bowl's shaded photographic contour, not the sink itself.
bowlmask=polygon([(73,52),(76,49),(81,48),(89,48),(96,49),(101,52),(103,56),(101,61),(96,64),(84,65),(77,62),(73,58)])
bowlmask *= np.clip(1-LH,0,1)
bowltex=SRC.astype(float).copy()
# The small hidden lower rim is completed from adjacent ceramic material.
for y in range(60,65):
    for x in range(74,103):
        if LH[y,x]>.15:
            bowltex[y,x]=np.array([201,203,195]) - (y-60)*2
            bowlmask[y,x]=max(bowlmask[y,x], float(((x-88)/15)**2+((y-55)/10)**2<1))
# Most of the contour remains the exact photographed ceramic texture.

# Top-facing thin sticks lie together across the sink, highly lit before pickup.
stickcenter=np.array([134.,46.5])
sticklen=51.
stickangle=math.radians(2.1)
stickmask=Image.new('L',(W*4,H*4));sd=ImageDraw.Draw(stickmask)
for off in [-1.35,1.35]:
    u=np.array([math.cos(stickangle),math.sin(stickangle)])
    n=np.array([-u[1],u[0]])
    a=stickcenter-u*sticklen/2+n*off;b=stickcenter+u*sticklen/2+n*off
    sd.line([tuple(a*4),tuple(b*4)],fill=255,width=5)
stickmask=np.array(stickmask.resize((W,H),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)).astype(float)/255

# Three-dimensional kinematic chain. The orthographic camera stays entirely fixed.
# The z component accounts for changes in foreshortening while link lengths stay fixed.
LS=np.array([104.,172.,0.]);LE=np.array([64.,114.,34.]);LW=np.array([82.,77.,0.])
RS=np.array([157.,173.,0.]);RE=np.array([188.,116.,34.]);RW=np.array([168.,78.,0.])

def ik(s,e0,w0,w):
    l1=np.linalg.norm(e0-s);l2=np.linalg.norm(w0-e0)
    axis=w-s;dist=np.linalg.norm(axis);axis/=dist
    foot=(l1*l1-l2*l2+dist*dist)/(2*dist)
    bend=e0-s-axis*np.dot(e0-s,axis);bend/=np.linalg.norm(bend)
    e=s+foot*axis+math.sqrt(max(0,l1*l1-foot*foot))*bend
    return e

def smooth(t):
    t=np.clip(t,0,1)
    return t*t*(3-2*t)

def trans(a,b,aa,bb,widthscale=1.):
    # Local orthographic projection of a rigid 3-D link, with stable thickness.
    a=np.asarray(a)[:2];b=np.asarray(b)[:2];aa=np.asarray(aa)[:2];bb=np.asarray(bb)[:2]
    v=b-a;u=bb-aa
    ln=np.linalg.norm(v);nn=np.linalg.norm(u)
    basis=np.column_stack((v/ln,np.array([-v[1],v[0]])/ln))
    new=np.column_stack((u/ln,np.array([-u[1],u[0]])/nn*widthscale))
    m=new@basis.T
    return m,aa-m@a

def rotate_asset(origin,position,angle):
    c=math.cos(angle);s=math.sin(angle);m=np.array([[c,-s],[s,c]])
    return m,np.asarray(position)[:2]-m@np.asarray(origin)[:2]

GRID=np.stack([X,Y],axis=-1).astype(float)

def warped(rgb,mask,m,t):
    inv=np.linalg.inv(m)
    coords=(GRID-t)@inv.T
    xx=coords[:,:,0];yy=coords[:,:,1]
    x0=np.floor(xx).astype(int);y0=np.floor(yy).astype(int)
    fx=xx-x0;fy=yy-y0
    valid=(xx>=0)&(xx<W-1)&(yy>=0)&(yy<H-1)
    x0=np.clip(x0,0,W-2);y0=np.clip(y0,0,H-2)
    rgba=np.concatenate([rgb.astype(float),mask[...,None]],axis=2)
    v=(rgba[y0,x0]*(1-fx)[...,None]*(1-fy)[...,None]
       +rgba[y0,x0+1]*fx[...,None]*(1-fy)[...,None]
       +rgba[y0+1,x0]*(1-fx)[...,None]*fy[...,None]
       +rgba[y0+1,x0+1]*fx[...,None]*fy[...,None])
    v[:,:,3]*=valid
    return v[:,:,:3],np.clip(v[:,:,3],0,1)

def paste(out,rgb,mask,m,t):
    color,alpha=warped(rgb,mask,m,t)
    return out*(1-alpha[...,None])+color*alpha[...,None]

def draw_sticks(out,center,angle,visibility):
    # Cylindrical wood: shaded sides, a narrow highlight and squared cut ends.
    scale=4
    layer=Image.new('RGBA',(W*scale,H*scale));d=ImageDraw.Draw(layer)
    u=np.array([math.cos(angle),math.sin(angle)]);n=np.array([-u[1],u[0]])
    for off in [-1.35,1.35]:
        a=center-u*sticklen/2+n*off;b=center+u*sticklen/2+n*off
        # top surface comes out of the saturated reflection as the rods are raised
        dark=np.array([83,51,29]);bright=np.array([142,104,65])
        rgb=np.rint(np.array([215,216,206])*(1-visibility)+dark*visibility).astype(int)
        pts=np.array([a-n*.75,b-n*.47,b+n*.47,a+n*.75])*scale
        d.polygon([tuple(p) for p in pts],fill=tuple(rgb)+(255,))
        high=np.rint(np.array([236,237,227])*(1-visibility)+bright*visibility).astype(int)
        d.line([tuple((a-n*.28)*scale),tuple((b-n*.21)*scale)],fill=tuple(high)+(245,),width=2)
        d.line([tuple((a-n*.65)*scale),tuple((a+n*.65)*scale)],fill=tuple(np.maximum(rgb-12,0))+(240,),width=2)
    layer=np.array(layer.resize((W,H),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)).astype(float)
    alpha=layer[:,:,3:4]/255
    return out*(1-alpha)+layer[:,:,:3]*alpha

frames=[SRC.copy()]
metrics=[]
for frame in range(1,20):
    # Ease into the approach, pause to make contact, close, then lift together.
    p=smooth(frame/10)
    close=smooth((frame-10)/3)
    lift=smooth((frame-13)/6)
    ltarget=np.array([89.,69.,-3.])
    rtarget=np.array([136.,63.,-4.])
    lw=LW+(ltarget-LW)*p+np.array([10.,-10.,-8.])*lift
    rw=RW+(rtarget-RW)*p+np.array([4.,-8.,-7.])*lift
    # Small controlled arc over the rim, followed by a vertical grasp approach.
    arch=math.sin(math.pi*p)
    lw[1]-=4.5*arch;rw[1]-=5.5*arch
    le=ik(LS,LE,LW,lw);re=ik(RS,RE,RW,rw)
    out=BASE_BG.astype(float).copy()
    # Restore the sink targets until a firm grasp has been completed.
    if lift>0:
        clear=np.clip(bowlmask+stickmask,0,1)
        sinkclean=SRC.astype(float).copy()
        # Surrounding white basin interpolated under the old bowl and sticks.
        for y in range(46,66):
            for x in range(70,105):
                t=(x-69)/36
                sinkclean[y,x]=SRC[y,69]*(1-t)+SRC[y,106]*t
        for y in range(40,53):
            for x in range(105,162):
                sinkclean[y,x]=.5*SRC[max(35,y-4),x]+.5*SRC[min(60,y+4),x]
        out=out*(1-clear[...,None])+sinkclean*clear[...,None]
    # Soft contact shadow on the bright basin shifts with the rigid held bowl.
    if lift>0:
        sh=np.exp(-(((X-88-lift*5)/16)**2+((Y-61)/4)**2))*lift*.12
        out*=1-sh[...,None]
    matrices={
        'lu':trans(LS,LE,LS,le), 'lf':trans(LE,LW,le,lw),
        'ru':trans(RS,RE,RS,re), 'rf':trans(RE,RW,re,rw),
    }
    la=math.radians(-4)*p+math.radians(4)*lift
    ra=math.radians(-5)*p+math.radians(10)*lift
    for k in ['lh','l1','l2']:
        m,t=rotate_asset(LW,lw,la)
        c={'lh':0,'l1':4.8,'l2':-4.8}[k]*close
        t+=m@np.array([c,0.])
        matrices[k]=(m,t)
    for k in ['rh','r1','r2']:
        m,t=rotate_asset(RW,rw,ra)
        c={'rh':0,'r1':4.4,'r2':-4.4}[k]*close
        t+=m@np.array([c,0.])
        matrices[k]=(m,t)
    # Back links first; the grasped objects lie between the rigid fingers.
    for name,mask in parts[:4]:
        out=paste(out,SRC,mask,*matrices[name])
    if lift>0:
        shift=np.array([10.,-10.])*lift
        bm,bt=rotate_asset(BOWL_CENTER,BOWL_CENTER+shift,math.radians(-3)*lift)
        out=paste(out,bowltex,bowlmask,bm,bt)
        # Reveal the smooth lit lip as it leaves the shadow of the sink.
        rim=Image.new('RGBA',(W*4,H*4));rd=ImageDraw.Draw(rim)
        cx,cy=BOWL_CENTER+shift
        rd.arc([(cx-14)*4,(cy-6)*4,(cx+14)*4,(cy+8)*4],192,341,fill=(239,241,232,round(70*lift)),width=3)
        ar=np.array(rim.resize((W,H),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)).astype(float);al=ar[:,:,3:]/255
        out=out*(1-al)+ar[:,:,:3]*al
        out=draw_sticks(out,stickcenter+np.array([4.,-8.])*lift,stickangle+math.radians(-13)*lift,lift)
    for name,mask in parts[4:]:
        out=paste(out,SRC,mask,*matrices[name])
    out=np.clip(out,0,255).astype(np.uint8)
    frames.append(out)
    metrics.append([frame,*lw,*le,*rw,*re,np.linalg.norm(le-LS),np.linalg.norm(lw-le),np.linalg.norm(re-RS),np.linalg.norm(rw-re)])
frames=np.stack(frames)
np.save(ROOT/'candidate_frames.npy',frames)
np.savetxt(ROOT/'kinematics_check.txt',metrics,fmt='%.5f')
artifact_io.save(frames,ROOT)
print('Saved',frames.shape,frames.dtype,'frame 00 exact:',np.array_equal(frames[0],SRC))
print('Largest fixed 3-D length deviation:',np.ptp(np.array(metrics)[:,-4:],axis=0))

from pathlib import Path
import math
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter
import artifact_io

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
W,H = 256,192
SRC = np.array(Image.open(ROOT/'first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
Y,X = np.mgrid[:H,:W]

def polygon(points):
    im=Image.new('L',(W*4,H*4)); d=ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    d.polygon([(round(x*4),round(y*4)) for x,y in points],fill=255)
    return np.array(im.resize((W,H),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)).astype(float)/255

# Each material patch belongs to exactly one rigid mechanical component.
LH=polygon([(54,78),(55,70),(62,67),(70,65),(78,61),(85,62),(90,64),(101,65),(105,68),(105,77),(100,79),(89,79),(80,83),(67,81),(61,79)])
LF=polygon([(70,78),(86,78),(90,82),(84,91),(78,101),(76,109),(73,118),(66,122),(57,119),(54,115),(56,107),(62,100),(66,98),(68,89),(65,83)])
LU=polygon([(57,114),(64,111),(72,117),(71,126),(76,136),(83,149),(91,154),(102,153),(109,157),(111,162),(106,168),(103,174),(94,175),(86,169),(82,161),(78,156),(71,145),(65,134),(60,125)])
RH=polygon([(146,76),(149,69),(154,67),(163,66),(169,64),(176,62),(183,64),(186,66),(195,67),(195,70),(190,74),(193,78),(187,81),(177,82),(167,80),(157,79)])
RF=polygon([(152,78),(164,76),(177,78),(182,85),(185,91),(179,99),(178,103),(186,109),(194,113),(194,118),(190,123),(185,126),(178,122),(172,117),(166,111),(169,104),(168,100),(155,99),(153,91)])
RU=polygon([(185,114),(194,115),(194,123),(185,132),(179,142),(174,151),(168,158),(166,164),(166,169),(158,177),(150,173),(148,167),(150,158),(149,154),(155,152),(165,155),(169,149),(176,138),(181,127),(177,122),(178,116)])
# Keep the bright fixed kitchen edge out of the moving link.
RU *= np.where((Y>126)&(SRC.mean(2)>105),0,1)
# Split fingers along their physical gap. Palm remains a separate rigid part.
left_finger=LH*polygon([(49,59),(80,59),(81,70),(73,77),(66,82),(49,83)])
right_finger=LH*polygon([(83,59),(110,60),(110,80),(90,82),(82,73)])
left_palm=np.maximum(0,LH-np.maximum(left_finger,right_finger))
r_f1=RH*polygon([(145,59),(166,59),(168,71),(158,80),(144,82)])
r_f2=RH*polygon([(169,59),(199,59),(199,82),(180,85),(168,74)])
r_palm=np.maximum(0,RH-np.maximum(r_f1,r_f2))

# Depth-sorted cutouts keep the photographed surface and all mechanical details.
parts=[('lu',LU),('ru',RU),('lf',LF),('rf',RF),('lh',left_palm),('l1',left_finger),('l2',right_finger),('rh',r_palm),('r1',r_f1),('r2',r_f2)]
remove=np.maximum.reduce([p[1] for p in parts])

# Reconstruct only surfaces formerly hidden by the arm; fixed pixels are untouched.
# The central strip is the same counter/sink material at the same perspective depth.
bg=SRC.astype(float).copy()
rng=np.random.default_rng(13)
fill=np.zeros_like(bg)
for y in range(H):
    row=SRC[y,112:143].astype(float)
    mean=np.median(row,axis=0)
    if y<69:
        row=SRC[y,112:142].astype(float)
        mean=np.median(row,axis=0)
    for x in range(W):
        sample=row[(x*7+11)%len(row)]
        fill[y,x]=mean + (sample-mean)*.36
# A gentle local interpolation restores reflective sink shading behind each wrist.
for y in range(60,72):
    for x in range(47,111):
        mix=np.clip((x-47)/64,0,1)
        a=SRC[y,45].astype(float);b=SRC[y,114].astype(float)
        fill[y,x]=a*(1-mix)+b*mix
    for x in range(146,197):
        fill[y,x]=np.median(SRC[y,116:141],axis=0)
# A little random but stationary microtexture prevents flat painted-out silhouettes.
noise=rng.normal(0,.65,(H,W,1))
fill=np.clip(fill+noise,0,255)
bg=bg*(1-remove[...,None])+fill*remove[...,None]
# Keep invariant bases and the parts of the workspace not exposed by the motion.
BASE_BG=bg.astype(np.uint8)
Image.fromarray(BASE_BG).save(ROOT/'background_candidate.png')

BOWL_CENTER=np.array([88.,54.])
# Ceramic bowl's shaded photographic contour, not the sink itself.
bowlmask=polygon([(73,52),(76,49),(81,48),(89,48),(96,49),(101,52),(103,56),(101,61),(96,64),(84,65),(77,62),(73,58)])
bowlmask *= np.clip(1-LH,0,1)
bowltex=SRC.astype(float).copy()
# The small hidden lower rim is completed from adjacent ceramic material.
for y in range(60,65):
    for x in range(74,103):
        if LH[y,x]>.15:
            bowltex[y,x]=np.array([201,203,195]) - (y-60)*2
            bowlmask[y,x]=max(bowlmask[y,x], float(((x-88)/15)**2+((y-55)/10)**2<1))
# Most of the contour remains the exact photographed ceramic texture.

# Top-facing thin sticks lie together across the sink, highly lit before pickup.
stickcenter=np.array([134.,46.5])
sticklen=51.
stickangle=math.radians(2.1)
stickmask=Image.new('L',(W*4,H*4));sd=ImageDraw.Draw(stickmask)
for off in [-1.35,1.35]:
    u=np.array([math.cos(stickangle),math.sin(stickangle)])
    n=np.array([-u[1],u[0]])
    a=stickcenter-u*sticklen/2+n*off;b=stickcenter+u*sticklen/2+n*off
    sd.line([tuple(a*4),tuple(b*4)],fill=255,width=5)
stickmask=np.array(stickmask.resize((W,H),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)).astype(float)/255

# Three-dimensional kinematic chain. The orthographic camera stays entirely fixed.
# The z component accounts for changes in foreshortening while link lengths stay fixed.
LS=np.array([104.,172.,0.]);LE=np.array([64.,114.,34.]);LW=np.array([82.,77.,0.])
RS=np.array([157.,173.,0.]);RE=np.array([188.,116.,34.]);RW=np.array([168.,78.,0.])

def ik(s,e0,w0,w):
    l1=np.linalg.norm(e0-s);l2=np.linalg.norm(w0-e0)
    axis=w-s;dist=np.linalg.norm(axis);axis/=dist
    foot=(l1*l1-l2*l2+dist*dist)/(2*dist)
    bend=e0-s-axis*np.dot(e0-s,axis);bend/=np.linalg.norm(bend)
    e=s+foot*axis+math.sqrt(max(0,l1*l1-foot*foot))*bend
    return e

def smooth(t):
    t=np.clip(t,0,1)
    return t*t*(3-2*t)

def trans(a,b,aa,bb,widthscale=1.):
    # Local orthographic projection of a rigid 3-D link, with stable thickness.
    a=np.asarray(a)[:2];b=np.asarray(b)[:2];aa=np.asarray(aa)[:2];bb=np.asarray(bb)[:2]
    v=b-a;u=bb-aa
    ln=np.linalg.norm(v);nn=np.linalg.norm(u)
    basis=np.column_stack((v/ln,np.array([-v[1],v[0]])/ln))
    new=np.column_stack((u/ln,np.array([-u[1],u[0]])/nn*widthscale))
    m=new@basis.T
    return m,aa-m@a

def rotate_asset(origin,position,angle):
    c=math.cos(angle);s=math.sin(angle);m=np.array([[c,-s],[s,c]])
    return m,np.asarray(position)[:2]-m@np.asarray(origin)[:2]

GRID=np.stack([X,Y],axis=-1).astype(float)

def warped(rgb,mask,m,t):
    inv=np.linalg.inv(m)
    coords=(GRID-t)@inv.T
    xx=coords[:,:,0];yy=coords[:,:,1]
    x0=np.floor(xx).astype(int);y0=np.floor(yy).astype(int)
    fx=xx-x0;fy=yy-y0
    valid=(xx>=0)&(xx<W-1)&(yy>=0)&(yy<H-1)
    x0=np.clip(x0,0,W-2);y0=np.clip(y0,0,H-2)
    rgba=np.concatenate([rgb.astype(float),mask[...,None]],axis=2)
    v=(rgba[y0,x0]*(1-fx)[...,None]*(1-fy)[...,None]
       +rgba[y0,x0+1]*fx[...,None]*(1-fy)[...,None]
       +rgba[y0+1,x0]*(1-fx)[...,None]*fy[...,None]
       +rgba[y0+1,x0+1]*fx[...,None]*fy[...,None])
    v[:,:,3]*=valid
    return v[:,:,:3],np.clip(v[:,:,3],0,1)

def paste(out,rgb,mask,m,t):
    color,alpha=warped(rgb,mask,m,t)
    return out*(1-alpha[...,None])+color*alpha[...,None]

def draw_sticks(out,center,angle,visibility):
    # Cylindrical wood: shaded sides, a narrow highlight and squared cut ends.
    scale=4
    layer=Image.new('RGBA',(W*scale,H*scale));d=ImageDraw.Draw(layer)
    u=np.array([math.cos(angle),math.sin(angle)]);n=np.array([-u[1],u[0]])
    for off in [-1.35,1.35]:
        a=center-u*sticklen/2+n*off;b=center+u*sticklen/2+n*off
        # top surface comes out of the saturated reflection as the rods are raised
        dark=np.array([83,51,29]);bright=np.array([142,104,65])
        rgb=np.rint(np.array([215,216,206])*(1-visibility)+dark*visibility).astype(int)
        pts=np.array([a-n*.75,b-n*.47,b+n*.47,a+n*.75])*scale
        d.polygon([tuple(p) for p in pts],fill=tuple(rgb)+(255,))
        high=np.rint(np.array([236,237,227])*(1-visibility)+bright*visibility).astype(int)
        d.line([tuple((a-n*.28)*scale),tuple((b-n*.21)*scale)],fill=tuple(high)+(245,),width=2)
        d.line([tuple((a-n*.65)*scale),tuple((a+n*.65)*scale)],fill=tuple(np.maximum(rgb-12,0))+(240,),width=2)
    layer=np.array(layer.resize((W,H),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)).astype(float)
    alpha=layer[:,:,3:4]/255
    return out*(1-alpha)+layer[:,:,:3]*alpha

frames=[SRC.copy()]
metrics=[]
for frame in range(1,20):
    # Ease into the approach, pause to make contact, close, then lift together.
    p=smooth(frame/10)
    close=smooth((frame-10)/3)
    lift=smooth((frame-13)/6)
    ltarget=np.array([89.,69.,-3.])
    rtarget=np.array([136.,63.,-4.])
    lw=LW+(ltarget-LW)*p+np.array([10.,-10.,-8.])*lift
    rw=RW+(rtarget-RW)*p+np.array([4.,-8.,-7.])*lift
    # Small controlled arc over the rim, followed by a vertical grasp approach.
    arch=math.sin(math.pi*p)
    lw[1]-=4.5*arch;rw[1]-=5.5*arch
    le=ik(LS,LE,LW,lw);re=ik(RS,RE,RW,rw)
    out=BASE_BG.astype(float).copy()
    # Restore the sink targets until a firm grasp has been completed.
    if lift>0:
        clear=np.clip(bowlmask+stickmask,0,1)
        sinkclean=SRC.astype(float).copy()
        # Surrounding white basin interpolated under the old bowl and sticks.
        for y in range(46,66):
            for x in range(70,105):
                t=(x-69)/36
                sinkclean[y,x]=SRC[y,69]*(1-t)+SRC[y,106]*t
        for y in range(40,53):
            for x in range(105,162):
                sinkclean[y,x]=.5*SRC[max(35,y-4),x]+.5*SRC[min(60,y+4),x]
        out=out*(1-clear[...,None])+sinkclean*clear[...,None]
    # Soft contact shadow on the bright basin shifts with the rigid held bowl.
    if lift>0:
        sh=np.exp(-(((X-88-lift*5)/16)**2+((Y-61)/4)**2))*lift*.12
        out*=1-sh[...,None]
    matrices={
        'lu':trans(LS,LE,LS,le), 'lf':trans(LE,LW,le,lw),
        'ru':trans(RS,RE,RS,re), 'rf':trans(RE,RW,re,rw),
    }
    la=math.radians(-4)*p+math.radians(4)*lift
    ra=math.radians(-5)*p+math.radians(10)*lift
    for k in ['lh','l1','l2']:
        m,t=rotate_asset(LW,lw,la)
        c={'lh':0,'l1':4.8,'l2':-4.8}[k]*close
        t+=m@np.array([c,0.])
        matrices[k]=(m,t)
    for k in ['rh','r1','r2']:
        m,t=rotate_asset(RW,rw,ra)
        c={'rh':0,'r1':4.4,'r2':-4.4}[k]*close
        t+=m@np.array([c,0.])
        matrices[k]=(m,t)
    # Back links first; the grasped objects lie between the rigid fingers.
    for name,mask in parts[:4]:
        out=paste(out,SRC,mask,*matrices[name])
    if lift>0:
        shift=np.array([10.,-10.])*lift
        bm,bt=rotate_asset(BOWL_CENTER,BOWL_CENTER+shift,math.radians(-3)*lift)
        out=paste(out,bowltex,bowlmask,bm,bt)
        # Reveal the smooth lit lip as it leaves the shadow of the sink.
        rim=Image.new('RGBA',(W*4,H*4));rd=ImageDraw.Draw(rim)
        cx,cy=BOWL_CENTER+shift
        rd.arc([(cx-14)*4,(cy-6)*4,(cx+14)*4,(cy+8)*4],192,341,fill=(239,241,232,round(70*lift)),width=3)
        ar=np.array(rim.resize((W,H),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)).astype(float);al=ar[:,:,3:]/255
        out=out*(1-al)+ar[:,:,:3]*al
        out=draw_sticks(out,stickcenter+np.array([4.,-8.])*lift,stickangle+math.radians(-13)*lift,lift)
    for name,mask in parts[4:]:
        out=paste(out,SRC,mask,*matrices[name])
    out=np.clip(out,0,255).astype(np.uint8)
    frames.append(out)
    metrics.append([frame,*lw,*le,*rw,*re,np.linalg.norm(le-LS),np.linalg.norm(lw-le),np.linalg.norm(re-RS),np.linalg.norm(rw-re)])
frames=np.stack(frames)
np.save(ROOT/'candidate_frames.npy',frames)
np.savetxt(ROOT/'kinematics_check.txt',metrics,fmt='%.5f')
artifact_io.save(frames,ROOT)
print('Saved',frames.shape,frames.dtype,'frame 00 exact:',np.array_equal(frames[0],SRC))
print('Largest fixed 3-D length deviation:',np.ptp(np.array(metrics)[:,-4:],axis=0))
